answer_text:
Short answer: Northwind CRM Essentials. Here's the rundown:

1. Northwind CRM — powerful and well supported, though per-seat costs climb quickly past the starter tier.
2. Pipewell — pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages.
3. Sheetly — the cheapest route: a shared sheet with CRM templates.

Honestly, start with Northwind CRM if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Pipewell if you expect to need deeper reporting.
